summary: Tested Phase 2/3: agents.vote and weights_from_audit units, audit.validate, luchii_backtest (day_windows, walk_forward_days, approve_walk_forward, monte_carlo_ruin, indicator cache), the strategy.evaluate agent gate, the new APIs (/strategy/agents, /strategy/montecarlo, /strategy/walkforward/{asset}) and the ValidationCard UI. New suite tests/test_iteration13_validation.py passed 31/31. I ran a real 7-day job (done in about 50s, 0 windows, 3 skipped, REJECTED) and a real 30-day job started from the UI (done in about 3.5 min, 43,500 candles, REJECTED, as expected). Full serial regression: 259/260 pass. The one failure is test_iteration9 test_paper_execute_alt_then_reset ('Event loop is closed'). It passes when its class and file are rerun (67/67), so it is an order-dependent flaky test. The UI works as specified with no console errors. One real HIGH bug: a running backtest changes the live strategy RULES.

critical.issue: run_backtest edits the module-global strategy.RULES (entry thresholds + atr_stop_mult) in place for each grid parameter set and restores them only in its finally block. It runs in a thread executor inside the same backend process as the live engine, which imports the same strategy module. So during a 1-3 min walk-forward job, every live and paper bot evaluate() trades with the grid's params (rsi_min 52, volume_min 1.2, atr_stop 2.0, etc.) instead of production rules. That affects entries and stop distances. Confirmed with tests/it13_rules_mutation_probe.py: while a backtest ran in a thread, the main thread read RULES=(52, 1.2, 2.0).

minor.issue: regimes.append(i['regime']) records the regime at exit, not at entry. The 30-day result shows CHOP PF 0.03 even though the strategy never enters in CHOP. Store the regime when the trade opens.

The cache key is id(list)+len+first t, and _IND_CACHE is a global dict with no lock. Concurrent jobs from two users can clear() it between the store and the return (KeyError). A recycled id() could also return a stale series. Key on content (first/last t + len) and return the local 'out'.

The CPU-bound backtest runs in a thread and holds the GIL, so API latency rose from about 0.1s to about 1.5s while the job ran. Consider a ProcessPoolExecutor, which would also fix the RULES-mutation bug.

Weights live in memory and are refreshed only when bot.weights_ts is more than 600s old. After a backend restart, weights default to 1.0 for up to 10 min even though bot.agent_weights is stored. Load bot.agent_weights as the fallback.
Job state is in memory: a restart loses queued/running status, and nothing limits concurrent jobs across users.

issues: All text is 9px, which is hard to read. The agent reason line wraps under the scores.
The admin BTC result line shows 'MC ruin 0%' next to REJECTED with 0 windows, which reads oddly. Consider showing the reason (e.g. 'no windows passed train PF>=1.10').

action_items: HIGH: stop run_backtest from changing the shared strategy.RULES. Either pass the params into evaluate/entry_score explicitly, use a deep-copied RULES per backtest, or run the walk-forward in a separate process (ProcessPoolExecutor).
Record the entry regime in run_backtest for regime_pf
Make the indicator_series cache thread-safe and content-keyed
Fall back to bot.agent_weights when AGENT_WEIGHTS has no entry for the user
critical_code_review_comments: strategy.RULES global mutation in luchii_backtest.run_backtest leaks into the live engine (see the HIGH issue)

agents.vote regime_ok: any permitted agent scoring >=75 enables the trade even when the winner is not permitted (e.g. TREND_BULL with volume winning and trend at 78). This is by design per the spec, but note it.
ValidationCard RUN always sends days=30. The 30-day job took about 3.5 min under load, longer than the toast's '~1-2 min'.
Partial TP slices count as separate trades in trade_pnls, which inflates the trade count for Monte Carlo and the walk-forward

success_rate.backend: 97% (31/31 new tests pass; 1 HIGH design bug found by a probe; full regression 259/260 with 1 order-dependent flaky test)

seed_data_creation: Only temporary test_it13_* users, with trade_audit/backtests rows. All cleaned up (0 left). The admin's data was not touched, and RUN was not clicked as admin.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests -q -n0. tests/it13_rules_mutation_probe.py should print the default RULES (55, 1.5, 2.5) once the RULES bug is fixed. tests/it13_wf_job_probe.py runs one 7-day job for a fresh user (about 1 min). The admin's BTC result currently shows 0 windows, REJECTED. test_iteration9 TestConfigApi::test_paper_execute_alt_then_reset can fail with 'Event loop is closed' in the full serial run but passes when rerun.
rca of the issue: run_backtest() does strategy.RULES['entry'].update(...) and sets RULES['risk']['atr_stop_mult'] for each grid combo (81 combos x N windows), and only restores them in finally. _run_wf runs this through loop.run_in_executor (a thread in the same process). engine.decide -> strategy.evaluate reads the same dict on the event loop thread, so live decisions use whatever grid combo is active. Repro: tests/it13_rules_mutation_probe.py. Fix: make the rules a parameter (evaluate(..., rules=...)), or run backtests in a subprocess.
